comments.author: emulsifier
comments.html: I love this series. Although I liked the original subtitle better. Or at least what I think in my head every time I read this one.

comments.author: cbobgo
comments.html: wow her ass is really big in this one

comments.author: Phil C.
comments.html:
She’s BACK! So delighted you’re taking this one up again. I love the reactions of the guys that encounter her. I also love that she’s a big curvy girl instead of a stick-thin waif. Never understood the Kate Moss attraction thing…..

Keep writing and drawing!

cheers,
Phil

comments.author: Motmaitre
comments.html: Ah yes. A big, gorgeous butt will lure any man away from his sweetheart. I too have many a rotund, magnificient butt portrayed on my webcomic. And my babes are hotter than she is, I declare! Decide for yourself at http://www.blackflycomic.com (largely NSFW)

comments.author: kitschbot
comments.html:
Phil C., I don’t mean to be hypercritical but that isn’t a big curvy girl… she’s a normal sized girl with a lump on her ass and bigger tits than usual. Big girls have bigger everything and this one isn’t very curved.

And what’s up with her feet? She was born with 5 inch heels? I’ll take all those as part of the joke though huh.

comments.html: I really enjoy the “idea” of a single avatar of pinnacle beauty, even tho it is a completely ridiculous concept. Still should be an interesting read.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.html: I think Kitschbot likes his girls bigger than the ones you described. His definition of “big curvy girl” is just different than yours.

comments.author: b.patrick
comments.html: @kitschbot: Any charges of stereotypical adolescent male behavior leveled at me will undoubtedly prove to be valid – but I do make an effort. I try to have some interesting multi-dimensional female characters and while every story/comic may not, the site as a whole at least passes the Bechdel Test.

comments.author: kitschbot
comments.html:
Motmaitre, I wasn’t saying girls like that don’t exist, but they don’t count as “big girls” for me. If you consider those women “big”, I question your standard of “skinny”. Jonny Paycheck got it, although I’m not a he nor do I have a thing for big girls (untested, but pretty sure my skinny ass boyfriend is somewhat proof).

b.patrick, I think it was precisely because I usually find your comics insightful and your humor intelligent that I was surprised to see this. Now that you mention the Bechdel Test, I may have to inspect to see if you live up to that claim. 😉 I kid, but I certainly have noticed that you do make an effort, otherwise I wouldn’t be coming here all the time making controversial comments!
